an4.114:1.1: catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati
an4.114:1.3: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā ca hoti hantā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an4.114:2.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti
an4.114:2.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi kāraṇaṃ kāreti
an4.114:2.3: yadi vā katapubbaṃ yadi vā akatapubbaṃ
an4.114:2.4: taṃ aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto suṇāti
an4.114:2.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo sotā hoti.
an4.114:3.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti
an4.114:3.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato hatthimpi hanati hatthārūhampi hanati assampi hanati assārūhampi hanati rathampi hanati rathikampi hanati pattikampi hanati
an4.114:3.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo hantā hoti.
an4.114:4.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti
an4.114:4.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo saṃgāmagato khamo hoti sattippahārānaṃ asippahārānaṃ usuppahārānaṃ bheripaṇavasaṃkhatiṇavaninnādasaddānaṃ
an4.114:4.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo khantā hoti.
an4.114:5.1: kathañca bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti
an4.114:5.2: idha bhikkhave rañño nāgo yamenaṃ hatthidammasārathi disaṃ peseti
an4.114:5.3: yadi vā gatapubbaṃ yadi vā agatapubbaṃ
an4.114:5.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhave rañño nāgo gantā hoti.
an4.114:5.6: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo rājāraho hoti rājabhoggo rañño aṅgantveva saṃkhaṃ gacchati.
an4.114:6.1: evameva kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa
an4.114:6.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā ca hoti hantā ca khantā ca gantā ca.
an4.114:7.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu tathāgatappavedite dhammavinaye desiyamāne aṭṭhikatvā manasikatvā sabbaṃ cetaso samannāharitvā ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti
an4.114:7.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sotā hoti.
an4.114:8.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannaṃ kāmavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti uppannaṃ byāpādavitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti uppannaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti uppannuppanne pāpake akusale dhamme nādhivāseti pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti
an4.114:8.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu hantā hoti.
an4.114:9.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khamo hoti sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsamakasavātātapasiriṃsapasamphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ uppannānaṃ sārīrikānaṃ vedanānaṃ dukkhānaṃ tibbānaṃ kharānaṃ kaṭukānaṃ asātānaṃ amanāpānaṃ pāṇaharānaṃ adhivāsakajātiko hoti
an4.114:9.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu khantā hoti.
an4.114:10.2: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yā disā agatapubbā iminā dīghena addhunā yadidaṃ sabbasaṃkhārasamatho sabbupadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhakkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ taṃ khippaññeva gantā hoti
an4.114:10.3: evaṃ kho bhikkhave bhikkhu gantā hoti.
an4.114:10.4: imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu āhuneyyo hoti pāhuneyyo dakkhiṇeyyo añjalikaraṇīyo anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
